geeklist.title: GAMESGALORE’S 2025 BGG AUCTION #29 – BIG POST-THANKSGIVING AUCTION – ENDS TUESDAY, DECEMBER 2ND!!
geeklist.description:
This might be my last auction of the year, so we’ll make it a good one! Here are some fantastic games to bring home for the holidays! Every year, I acquire too many of the Essen Spiel releases, and this year is no different. Accordingly, in this auction you’ll find some wonderful and unique games that were released last year that I just never got around to playing…so here they are now up for auction!! All of the games are complete and in great shape! If you want some really unique games to add to your collection or to play over the holidays, this is where to find them!! Check them out and grab the ones you want!! More details of this sale follow:
[u][b]The Auction - Specifics[/b][/u]
[b]1. This is a BGG Flea Market auction…all sales will be run through BGG [u]in bulk[/u] so BGG receives its commission! 2. Auction Ends – Tuesday, December 2nd[/b] 3. All buyers welcome…will ship worldwide 4. All bids must be in whole US dollar increments 5. Please add a zip code to all bids as this expedites the billing process at the end of the auction 6. All games will have a minimum bid AND a Buy It Now (BIN) price…no “reserves” 7. The auction will end on December 2nd after there is no activity for a period of one hour past 8pm EST that evening 8. If there is activity from 8pm to 9pm EST that evening, the auction for that item will be extended by one hour 9. This will continue until an hour goes by with no activity on the item, at which point the auction will end
[b]Payments & Shipping[/b]
1. You will receive a billing notice from me through Geekmail regarding your auction winnings 2. [u]BGG gets its commission from a single “bulk bill” at the end of the auction[/u]. The winning bidders will receive a billing notice through GeekMail from me…the sales will [u][b]NOT[/b][/u] individually run through the BGG Marketplace. This is a standard and accepted practice from BGG and they will get their full commission at the end of the auction! 3. Payments will be through PayPal at the end of the auction 4. Payment is expected [u][b]within three days of the close of the auction; this is very important…please make payment promptly![/b][/u] 5. Shipping will be through USPS Priority Mail, USPS International Mail or UPS 6. Buyer is responsible for shipping costs 7. Shipping will be from zip code 43021 8. I will combine games to get the best shipping prices 9. You are welcome to pick up your games locally (in the Columbus, OH area) if you want to save the shipping and handling charges. We can make arrangements post-auction.
That’s it! Good luck to everyone and thank you for your interest. Please feel free to contact me through BGG if you have any questions!
Lyle Rhodebeck Gamesgalore
